projects.title: Lycosa
projects.summary: A LAN-first distributed platform for orchestrating local and cloud AI agents.
projects.description: Lycosa turns workstations, laptops, homelab systems, and mini-PCs into a cooperative AI execution fabric. Its controller discovers devices, recommends roles from their hardware, schedules tasks with failover, routes RAG knowledge requests, coordinates approval-gated workflows, and streams live operations into a cross-platform desktop dashboard.

visualJourney.title: From node inventory to execution graph
visualJourney.description: Two complementary views of the distributed AI fabric: operational node details and the live controller topology.

images.alt: Lycosa desktop dashboard showing connected AI nodes in a list
images.caption: Live node inventory
images.description: Machine status, assigned roles, recommendations, heartbeat timing, CPU, and memory are visible in one operational list.

images.alt: Lycosa desktop dashboard graph showing distributed AI nodes connected to a controller
images.caption: Distributed execution graph
images.description: An interactive topology shows registered devices, controller relationships, node roles, and live resource metrics.

projects.title: SafeHear-AI
projects.summary: An urban emergency-sound detection system powered by machine learning.
projects.description: SafeHear-AI is a CNN-based audio classifier for emergency and normal urban sounds. It achieved 97.02% validation accuracy using acoustic features, enabling sound-based situational awareness without visual surveillance.
